preconditions.text: A user cancels a withdrawal request via cancelWithdrawal, recording the associated HYPE value (totalHypeValueReturned) in _cancelledWithdrawalAmount.; An account with MANAGER_ROLE privileges calls redelegateWithdrawnHYPE.; Only accounts holding MANAGER_ROLE can invoke redelegateWithdrawnHYPE.

safety.text: Re-delegating a cancelled withdrawal amount should preserve the full HYPE value: any sub-1e10 remainder from 8-decimal conversion should be retained in hypeBuffer or otherwise accounted for, not dropped from accounting and delegation.
